testChange.reason: Two tests asserted a runtime refusal the union now makes unrepresentable in our own code — "creates nothing when the mode and its launch details disagree" (service) and "refuses launch details riding a mode that is not launching" (host). The agent fields are members of the agent variant, so no caller can build either arrangement. What survives is the boundary check: WorktreeHost keeps isKnownCreateMode/isKnownAfterCreate for a message whose type erased at the webview boundary, and "refuses an agent mode that describes no launch" still exercises it. One test was added in exchange — a fresh mode with no baseRef must reach git as newBranch, which is the defect this task repairs.
